# Setup
Change dataset.use to "my_data" for denoising metrics on this study's data or "phgg" for denoising metrics on the Sussman 2024 data
```{r}
dataset.use <- "phgg" # "my_data" or "phgg" or "herring2022"


root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R')))
data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, 'ExternalData/')
results.dir <- paste0(root.dir, 'Results/')

group.by <- "by_sample"

if (dataset.use == "phgg") {
  output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/denoising_metrics/sussman_2024/")
  seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3ByPatientFinal/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS'))
  
  seurat.obj.merged$patient.id <- seurat.obj.merged$patient_id
  seurat.obj.merged$group.by.col <- seurat.obj.merged$sample.id
  seurat.obj.merged$predicted.annotation_l1.w.qc <- seurat.obj.merged$annotation.l1.w.qc
  seurat.obj.merged$predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc <- seurat.obj.merged$annotation.l2.w.qc
  seurat.obj.merged$annotation <- seurat.obj.merged$annotation.l1.w.qc
  seurat.obj.merged$sample.plot <- seurat.obj.merged$patient.id
  vars.to.iter <- sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged$group.by.col))
  
} else if (dataset.use == "my_data") {
  output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/denoising_metrics/my_data/")
  
  seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.FALSE_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/", "all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))
  
  seurat.obj.merged$patient.id <- seurat.obj.merged$patient
  seurat.obj.merged$group.by.col <- seurat.obj.merged$sample.id
  seurat.obj.merged$Timepoint <- "Postmortem"
  seurat.obj.merged$timepoint <- "Postmortem"
  seurat.obj.merged$annotation <- seurat.obj.merged$predicted.annotation_l1
  seurat.obj.merged$sample.plot <- seurat.obj.merged$sample.id
  vars.to.iter <- sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged$group.by.col))
  
}  else if (dataset.use == "herring2022") {
  output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/denoising_metrics/herring_2022/")
  
  seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', 'all.sampled.merged.downsampled.seurat.obj.RDS'))
 
  seurat.obj.merged <- subset(seurat.obj.merged, subset = filter.out == FALSE) # remove very low quality
  
  seurat.obj.merged$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj.merged@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))
  
  # remove non-patient
  seurat.obj.merged <- subset(seurat.obj.merged, subset = is.sample.organoid_ == FALSE)

  seurat.obj.merged$patient.id <- seurat.obj.merged$geo.sample.id_
  seurat.obj.merged$sample.id <- seurat.obj.merged$library.id_
  seurat.obj.merged$group.by.col <- seurat.obj.merged$sample.id
  seurat.obj.merged$Timepoint <- "Postmortem"
  seurat.obj.merged$timepoint <- "Postmortem"
  seurat.obj.merged$annotation <- seurat.obj.merged$annotation_l1
  seurat.obj.merged$sample.plot <- seurat.obj.merged$sample.id
  vars.to.iter <- sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged$group.by.col))
  
} else {
  stop()
}

output.dir <- paste0(output.dir, group.by, "/")


sample.plot <- sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged$sample.plot))
sample.plot.color.scale <- scale_color_manual(breaks = sample.plot, values = as.character(polychrome(length(sample.plot))))

dir.create(paste0(output.dir))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "cell_type/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "mixing/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "plots/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "metrics/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "final/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "mixing/", "annotation/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "mixing/", "low.quality.by.qc/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "mixing/", "Timepoint/"))
```

# Metrics before and after denoising
Can skip this chunk if already run and go to next chunk
```{r, echo = T, results="hide"}
seurat.obj.merged$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj.merged@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))


jaccard <- function(a, b) {
    intersection = length(intersect(a, b))
    union = length(a) + length(b) - intersection
    return (intersection/union)
}

if (!use.saved.obj) {
  
  seurat.obj.merged <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.merged, all.gene.signatures)
  print(table(seurat.obj.merged$sample.id))
  
  seurat.obj.merged <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj.merged)
  seurat.obj.merged <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.merged)
}


for (i in 1:length(denoise.labels)) {
  denoise.label <- denoise.labels[[i]]
  print(denoise.label)

  save.filepath <- paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/", "seurat.obj_denoise=", denoise.label, ".RDS")
  if (use.saved.obj && file.exists(save.filepath)) {
      seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(save.filepath)
  } else {

    if (denoise.label == "FALSE") {
      denoise <- FALSE
    } else {
      denoise <- TRUE
    }

    if (denoise) {
      denoise.vars.to.regress <- unlist(str_split(denoise.label, "_"))
    }
    
    if (denoise) {
      seurat.obj.merged <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.merged, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.merged), vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
    } else {
      seurat.obj.merged <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.merged, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.merged))
    }
    
    set.seed(123)
    seurat.obj.merged <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.merged, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.merged), approx = T, seed.use = 42, verbose = F)
    
    saveRDS(seurat.obj.merged, save.filepath)
  }
  
  
  # evaluate by sample
  mm.metrics.df <- data.frame()
  sample_pc_jaccard <- list()
  sample_driver_genes_list <- list()
  
  n.pcs.to.test <- 10
  n.drivers.to.pull <- 50
    
  for (x in vars.to.iter) {
    print(x)
      
    # subset to sample
    seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj.merged, subset = group.by.col == x)
    
    for (pc_idx in 1:n.pcs.to.test) {
      pc_name <- paste0("PC_", pc_idx)
      
      # get driver genes per sample
      drivers <- get_sample_drivers(seurat.obj.merged, sample_id = x, pc = pc_name, n_genes = n.drivers.to.pull)
      
      # store driver genes
      for (direction in c("positive_drivers", "negative_drivers")) {
        sample_driver_genes_list[[length(sample_driver_genes_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          sample = x,
          PC = pc_idx,
          direction = gsub("_drivers", "", direction),
          gene = drivers[[direction]],
          denoise.label = as.character(denoise.label)
        )
      }
  
      # calculate Jaccard
      current_drivers_all <- unique(c(drivers$positive_drivers, drivers$negative_drivers))
      for (sig_name in names(gene.signatures)) {
        # Use your helper function here!
        j_val <- jaccard(current_drivers_all, gene.signatures[[sig_name]])
        
        sample_pc_jaccard[[length(sample_pc_jaccard) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          sample = x,
          PC = pc_idx,
          gene_signature = sig_name,
          jaccard_value = j_val,
          denoise.label = as.character(denoise.label)
        )
      }
    }
    
    
    # mixing metric of low-quality with high-quality
    print("running mixing_metric_seurat")

    for (grouping.var in c("low.quality.by.qc")) {
       mm <- mixing_metric_seurat(
        seurat.obj,
        group.by = grouping.var,
        metric = "seurat",
        k = k.use,
        dims = 1:n.dims.use
      )
      seurat.obj <- mm$seurat_object
      rm(mm)
      mm.df <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(group.by.col, sample.id, patient.id, Timepoint, mixing_seurat, low.quality.by.qc, annotation)
      mm.df$cell.barcode <- rownames(mm.df)
      mm.df$denoise <- denoise.label
      mm.df$grouping.var <- grouping.var
      mm.metrics.df <- rbind(mm.metrics.df, mm.df)
    }
  }
  
  # save results to metrics folder
  write.table(mm.metrics.df, paste0(output.dir, "metrics/", "mm.metrics_k=", k.use, "_1to", n.dims.use, "_denoise=", denoise.label, ".tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = F, quote = F)
  
  master_jaccard_df <- do.call(rbind, sample_pc_jaccard)
  write.table(master_jaccard_df, 
              paste0(output.dir, "metrics/", "pc_jaccard_denoise=", denoise.label, ".tsv"), 
              sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

  master_driver_genes_df <- do.call(rbind, sample_driver_genes_list)
  write.table(master_driver_genes_df, 
              paste0(output.dir, "metrics/", "driver_genes_list_denoise=", denoise.label, ".tsv"), 
              sep = "\t", row.names = F, quote = F)
  
}

```

# Supplemental: Loss of complexity analysis
```{r}
df <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:length(denoise.labels)) {
  denoise.label <- denoise.labels[[i]]
  print(denoise.label)

  save.filepath <- paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/", "seurat.obj_denoise=", denoise.label, ".RDS")
  seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(save.filepath)
  
  # 1. Extract standard deviations (stdev)
  pc_stdev <- seurat.obj.merged[["pca"]]@stdev
  
  # 2. Calculate variance
  pc_variance <- pc_stdev^2
  
  # 3. Calculate percent variance explained
  percent_variance <- (pc_variance / sum(pc_variance)) * 100
  
  # Create a data frame for easy viewing
  pca_importance <- data.frame(
    PC = paste0("PC_", 1:length(percent_variance)),
    Variance = pc_variance,
    Percent_Explained = percent_variance
  )  
  
  pca_importance$denoise.label <- denoise.label
  pca_importance$i <- 1:nrow(pca_importance)
  df <- rbind(df, pca_importance)
}

df$denoise.label <- sapply(df$denoise.label, function(x) case_when(
    x == "FALSE" ~ "No denoising", 
    x == "heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature" ~ "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, refined)",
    x == "heat.shock.signature.9_postmortem.sensitive.factor_postmortem.signature.factor" ~ "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, top 100 from factor)",
    x == "percent.mt" ~ "Percent mitochondrial reads", 
    x == "pm.degs.all_liv.degs.all" ~ "PM (n=6771) and LIV DEGs (n=7250)",
  ))

df <- df %>%
  group_by(denoise.label) %>%
  arrange(i) %>% 
  mutate(Cumulative_Explained = cumsum(Percent_Explained)) %>%
  ungroup()
denoising.methods.use <- c("No denoising", "Percent mitochondrial reads", "PM (n=6771) and LIV DEGs (n=7250)", "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, top 100 from factor)", "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, refined)")
df$denoise.label <- factor(df$denoise.label, denoising.methods.use)

dataset.name <- case_when(
  dataset.use == "phgg" ~ "Sussman 2024",
  dataset.use == "my_data" ~ "This study",
  dataset.use == "herring2022" ~ "Herring 2022",
  TRUE ~ NA
)

p <- ggplot(df %>% filter(i <= 30), aes(i, Cumulative_Explained, fill = denoise.label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position="dodge", color = "black") +
  xlab("PC") +
  ylab("Variance explained (cumulative %)") +
  labs(fill = "Method") +
  ggtitle(dataset.name)
  
pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, dataset.use, "_complexity_analysis.pdf"), width = 18, height = 8)
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# Main: Denoising improvement using Jaccard alignment to principal components and quality integration
Comparing multiple methods
```{r}
baseline.label <- "FALSE"   # baseline denoising condition
max.pc <- 5 # use top 5 PCs for analysis
control.signatures <- c(
    "random.genes.1",
    "random.genes.2",
    "random.genes.3"
  )
bio.signatures <- names(celltype_signatures)

grouping.var.i <- "low.quality.by.qc"

include.raw.factors <- F

summary.df <- data.frame()

# iterate through all datasets
for (dataset.use in c("phgg", "my_data", "herring2022")) {
  
  if (dataset.use == "phgg") {
    output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/denoising_metrics/sussman_2024/by_sample/")
    seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3ByPatientFinal/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS'))
    
  } else if (dataset.use == "my_data") {
    output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/denoising_metrics/my_data/by_sample/")
    seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.FALSE_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/", "all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))
    seurat.obj.merged$Timepoint <- "Postmortem"
    
  } else if (dataset.use == "herring2022") {
    output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/denoising_metrics/herring_2022/by_sample/")
     seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', 'all.sampled.merged.downsampled.seurat.obj.RDS'))
     seurat.obj.merged$Timepoint <- "Postmortem"
     seurat.obj.merged$sample.id <- seurat.obj.merged$library.id_
     
  } else {
    stop()
  }
  
  metrics.dir <- paste0(output.dir, "metrics/")
  
  
  
  ##### Jaccard alignment to principal components #####
  
  jaccard.files <- list.files(
    metrics.dir,
    pattern = "^pc_jaccard_denoise=.*\\.tsv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  jaccard.df <- map_dfr(
    jaccard.files,
    ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(denoise.label = as.character(denoise.label))
  )
  
  if (!include.raw.factors) {
    jaccard.df <- jaccard.df %>% filter(denoise.label != "heat.shock.signature.9_postmortem.sensitive.factor_postmortem.signature.factor")
    denoising.methods.use <- c("No denoising", "Percent mitochondrial reads", "PM (n=6771) and LIV DEGs (n=7250)", "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, refined)")
  } else {
    denoising.methods.use <- c("No denoising", "Percent mitochondrial reads", "PM (n=6771) and LIV DEGs (n=7250)", "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, top 100 from factor)", "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, refined)")
  }
  
  # keep PCs of interest
  jaccard.df <- jaccard.df %>%
    filter(PC <= max.pc)
  
  maxj.df <- jaccard.df %>%
    group_by(denoise.label, sample, gene_signature) %>%
    summarize(
      max_jaccard = max(jaccard_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # compute metric
  metric.per.sample <- maxj.df %>%
    mutate(
      sig_class = ifelse(
        gene_signature %in% control.signatures,
        "control",
        "bio"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(denoise.label, sample, sig_class) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_max_jaccard = mean(max_jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = sig_class,
      values_from = mean_max_jaccard
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      metric = bio - control
    )
  
  sample.meta <- seurat.obj.merged@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(sample.id, Timepoint) %>%
    distinct()
  
  metric.plot.df <- metric.per.sample %>%
    dplyr::rename(sample.id = sample) %>%
    left_join(sample.meta, by = "sample.id")
  
  metric.plot.df <- metric.plot.df %>%
    mutate(
      Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Postmortem", "Surgical"))
    )
  
  metric.plot.df$denoise.label <- sapply(metric.plot.df$denoise.label, function(x) case_when(
    x == baseline.label ~ "No denoising", 
    x == "heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature" ~ "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, refined)",
    x == "heat.shock.signature.9_postmortem.sensitive.factor_postmortem.signature.factor" ~ "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, top 100 from factor)",
    x == "percent.mt" ~ "Percent mitochondrial reads", 
    x == "pm.degs.all_liv.degs.all" ~ "PM (n=6771) and LIV DEGs (n=7250)",
  ))
  
  metric.plot.df$denoise.label <- factor(metric.plot.df$denoise.label, levels = denoising.methods.use)
  
  metric.plot.df <- metric.plot.df %>% 
    arrange(Timepoint, denoise.label)
  
  stat.test <- metric.plot.df %>%
    group_by(Timepoint) %>%
    wilcox_test(
      metric ~ denoise.label,
      ref.group = "No denoising",
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "less"
    ) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "denoise.label", step.increase = 0.2)
  stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p.adj)
  
  
  # PC alignment plot
  # TODO add labels for method
  p <- ggplot(
    metric.plot.df,
    aes(x = denoise.label, y = metric)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = sample.id),
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "grey"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = denoise.label),
      size = 2,
      shape = 21
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~Timepoint) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Cell type/state PC alignment"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      stat.test,
      label = "p.label",
      size = 6
    )
  
  pdf(
    paste0(
      figures.dir,
      dataset.use,
      "_denoising_vs_cell_type_state_PC_alignment.pdf"
    ),
    width = 14,
    height = 10
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  stat.test$dataset <- dataset.use
  stat.test$metric <- "PC alignment"
  
  summary.df <- rbind(summary.df, stat.test)
  
  
  ##### Supplemental: plot PC overlap with signatures for each PC #####
    
  # for plotting surgical then postmortem
  sample_order_map <- seurat.obj.merged@meta.data %>%
    select(sample.id, Timepoint) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(Timepoint) 
  
  sample_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(sample_order_map$sample.id, " (", sample_order_map$Timepoint, ")"),
    sample_order_map$sample.id
  )
  
  
  jaccard_files <- list.files(metrics.dir, 
                              pattern = "pc_jaccard_.*\\.tsv", 
                              full.names = TRUE)
  
  jaccard_files <- jaccard_files[endsWith(jaccard_files, "pc_jaccard_denoise=FALSE.tsv") | endsWith(jaccard_files, "pc_jaccard_denoise=heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature.tsv")] 
  
  master_jaccard_plot_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(jaccard_files, read.table, header = TRUE, sep = "\t"))
  
  master_jaccard_plot_df$status <- ifelse(master_jaccard_plot_df$denoise.label == "FALSE", "Before denoising", "After denoising")
  master_jaccard_plot_df$status <- factor(master_jaccard_plot_df$status, levels = c("Before denoising", "After denoising"))
  master_jaccard_plot_df$sample <- factor(master_jaccard_plot_df$sample, levels = sample_order_map$sample.id)
  
  signatures.use <- c(names(celltype_signatures), "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature", "heat.shock.signature", "mt.genes")
  master_jaccard_plot_df <- master_jaccard_plot_df %>% filter(gene_signature %in% signatures.use)
  master_jaccard_plot_df$gene_signature <- factor(master_jaccard_plot_df$gene_signature, levels = signatures.use)
  
  for (pc.use in 1:10) {
    p_jaccard <- ggplot(master_jaccard_plot_df %>% filter(PC == pc.use), 
                        aes(x = gene_signature, y = sample, fill = jaccard_value)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      facet_wrap(~status) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Jaccard Index") + 
      scale_y_discrete(labels = sample_labels) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = paste0("PC", pc.use),
           subtitle = "Overlap (Jaccard) of top genes in principal component and gene signatures",
           x = "Signature",
           y = "Sample (Timepoint)")
  
    pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "denoising_jaccard_plots/", dataset.use, "_pc_", pc.use, "_jaccard_plot.pdf"), width = 20, height = 12)
    print(p_jaccard)
    dev.off()
  }
  
  
  
  #### Quality integration metric ####
  mm.metrics.df <- data.frame()
  for (denoise.label in denoise.labels) {
    print(denoise.label)
    mm.metrics.i.df <- read.csv(paste0(output.dir, "metrics/", "mm.metrics_k=", k.use, "_1to", n.dims.use, "_denoise=", denoise.label, ".tsv"), sep = "\t")
    mm.metrics.i.df <- mm.metrics.i.df %>% dplyr::filter(grouping.var == grouping.var.i)
    mm.metrics.df <- rbind(mm.metrics.df, mm.metrics.i.df)
  }
  
  if (!include.raw.factors) {
    mm.metrics.df <- mm.metrics.df %>% filter(denoise != "heat.shock.signature.9_postmortem.sensitive.factor_postmortem.signature.factor")
  }
  
  mm.metrics.df$Denoise <- sapply(mm.metrics.df$denoise, function(x) case_when(
    x == baseline.label ~ "No denoising", 
    x == "heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature" ~ "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, refined)",
    x == "heat.shock.signature.9_postmortem.sensitive.factor_postmortem.signature.factor" ~ "Postmortem signatures\n(this study, top 100 from factor)",
    x == "percent.mt" ~ "Percent mitochondrial reads", 
    x == "pm.degs.all_liv.degs.all" ~ "PM (n=6771) and LIV DEGs (n=7250)",
  ))
  
  mm.metrics.df$Denoise <- factor(mm.metrics.df$Denoise, levels = denoising.methods.use)
  mm.metrics.df$Timepoint <- factor(mm.metrics.df$Timepoint, levels = c("Postmortem", "Surgical"))
  
  for (quality.use in c("low", "high", "all")) {
    
    if (quality.use == "low") {
      df <- mm.metrics.df %>% filter(low.quality.by.qc == TRUE)
    } else if (quality.use == "high") {
      df <- mm.metrics.df %>% filter(low.quality.by.qc == FALSE)
    } else {
      df <- mm.metrics.df
    }
    
    mixing.summary.df <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Timepoint, patient.id, sample.id, Denoise) %>%
      summarize(metric = mean(mixing_seurat)) %>%
      ungroup() %>% 
      arrange(Denoise, sample.id)
    
    stat.test <- mixing.summary.df %>%
      group_by(Timepoint) %>%
      wilcox_test(
        metric ~ Denoise,
        ref.group = "No denoising",
        paired = TRUE,
        alternative = "less"
      ) %>%
      adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
      add_significance("p.adj") %>%
      add_xy_position(x = "Denoise", step.increase = 1)
    stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p.adj)
    
    p <- ggplot(
        mixing.summary.df,
        aes(x = Denoise, y = metric)
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_line(aes(group = sample.id), alpha = 0.6, color = "grey") +
      geom_point(
        aes(fill = Denoise),
        size = 2,
        shape = 21
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~Timepoint) +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = "Quality integration metric",
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none"
      ) +
      stat_pvalue_manual(
        stat.test,
        label = "p.label",
        size = 6
      ) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    
    
    if (quality.use == "low") {
      pdf(paste0(figures.dir, dataset.use, "_denoising_vs_quality_integration_metric_quality.pdf"), width = 14, height = 10)
      print(p)
      dev.off()
      
      stat.test$dataset <- dataset.use
      stat.test$metric <- "Quality integration"
      
      summary.df <- rbind(summary.df, stat.test)
      
    } else {
      pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, dataset.use, "_denoising_vs_quality_integration_metric_quality.use=", quality.use, ".pdf"), width = 14, height = 10)
      print(p)
      dev.off()
    }
  }
}
```
